stories.headline: Struggle Against Sin Doesn’t Signal Defeat
Open letters about AI development
RFC 10015 Targets Outdated TLS 1.2 Key Exchanges
stories.summary: The new RFC proposes removing legacy key‑exchange algorithms from TLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.2 to strengthen security. Community discussion on Hacker News reflects strong support for modernizing the protocols.

stories.headline: Apple’s 0% iPhone Upgrade Program Looks Too Good to Be True
stories.summary: Michael Lopp points out that the Apple iPhone Upgrade Program lets consumers finance a full‑price phone at zero percent over two years, effectively turning the device into a loan. Critics argue the arrangement masks high long‑term costs and encourages debt.

stories.headline: Pork Soda
Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
Trump Announces Pause on Iran Attack Pending Deal
stories.summary: President Trump stated that Iran and regional allies requested a hold on U.S. strikes, citing an agreed perimeter for a potential agreement. The announcement ties the pause directly to diplomatic negotiations.

stories.headline: Russian Missile Barrage Kills Nine in Kyiv as U.S. Aid Stalls
stories.summary: Ballistic missiles struck five districts of Ukraine’s capital before dawn, causing nine fatalities. Meanwhile, President Trump is reconsidering a promised increase in missile defense support for Kyiv.

stories.headline: Kimi K3 on MI355X Beats B300 in Cost‑Performance Ratio
stories.summary: A benchmark shows the Kimi K3 accelerator paired with the MI355X chip delivers superior performance per dollar compared to the B300 setup. The findings sparked extensive discussion among hardware enthusiasts on Hacker News.

stories.headline: Ten Breakthroughs Reshaping Mathematics and Theoretical CS
stories.summary: Simon Willison curates a list of recent seminal advances, from new cryptographic insights to foundational algorithmic discoveries. The roundup emphasizes how these developments could steer future research directions.

stories.headline: Why 128‑Bit CPUs Never Took Off
stories.summary: John Mashey’s 1995 essay examines the technical promises of 128‑bit processors and why industry momentum stalled. He argues that software demands and cost outweighed any performance gains, leaving the architecture largely theoretical.

stories.headline: DR Congo Faces Deadliest Ebola Outbreak Yet, WHO Warns
stories.summary: The World Health Organization says the current Ebola wave in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 1,587 people, the highest toll on record. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists, intensifying the public‑health emergency.

stories.headline: AI Can Offer Solid Financial Advice—If You Phrase Queries Correctly
stories.summary: MIT Sloan research finds that large‑language‑model tools can produce useful investment recommendations when users ask precise, well‑structured questions. The study highlights both the potential and the need for careful prompt engineering to avoid misleading outputs.

stories.headline: Linux on a Handheld Calculator? It’s Possible
stories.summary: A hobbyist demonstrates how to port a stripped‑down Linux kernel onto a graphing calculator, turning the device into a tiny computer. The project showcases the flexibility of open‑source software and the curiosity of the maker community.

stories.headline: Works & Wonders (August 2)
A Young Scientist's Interview with a Bird Expert
stories.summary: In an inspiring encounter, a first-grader with aspirations in science was given the chance to interview a professional bird scientist. This unique opportunity allowed the young student to learn about conservation science and career paths in the field.

stories.headline: Ceuta Migrant Surge Sparks Political Turmoil Across Europe
stories.summary: Mass crossings into the Spanish enclave have exposed deep divisions among EU members over migration policy. Social‑media amplification has turned the crisis into a polarizing political flashpoint.

stories.headline: EU Calls Emergency Summit Over Ceuta Migrant Influx
stories.summary: European leaders convened an urgent meeting to address the sudden surge of migrants entering Ceuta from Morocco. The talks highlighted strained relations between Spain and other EU states over burden‑sharing and border control.

stories.headline: Four Distinct Time Horizons Shape Tech Adoption
stories.summary: Rodney Brooks outlines short‑term, medium‑term, long‑term, and ultra‑long‑term scales that influence how technologies move from labs to markets. Understanding these layers helps innovators set realistic expectations for deployment timelines.

stories.headline: Pedro Sánchez’s Migrant‑Friendly Reputation Tested After Ceuta Crisis
stories.summary: Spain’s prime minister, once praised for his pro‑immigration stance, now faces criticism at home and abroad following the arrival of roughly 60,000 migrants in Ceuta. The episode threatens his political capital and challenges his broader EU agenda.

stories.headline: Go 1.27 Launches Interactive Tour for Developers
stories.summary: The new release includes an interactive, browser‑based tutorial that walks programmers through language features and standard library usage. It aims to lower the learning curve and showcase performance improvements in Go 1.27.

stories.headline: Uganda Nears Ebola Victory as Last Patient Discharged
stories.summary: After weeks of intensive treatment, Uganda released its final Ebola case, marking a stark contrast to the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Health officials credit rapid vaccination and contact tracing for the success.

stories.headline: From Shacks to Modern Flats: Slum Residents Co‑Design New Housing
stories.summary: In a pioneering project, families living in cramped tin shacks helped plan and build a multi‑unit building, turning cramped conditions into spacious apartments. The initiative has already earned an international design award.

stories.headline: Australia Merges Tech and Indigenous Wisdom to Tame Wildfires
stories.summary: Facing record‑breaking fires in Europe, experts look to Australia’s blend of satellite monitoring, AI modeling, and Aboriginal fire‑management practices. The hybrid approach promises faster detection and more controlled burns.

stories.headline: Mass Return of Migrants Leaves Ceuta’s Border Calm
stories.summary: After tens of thousands crossed from Morocco into Spain’s enclave of Ceuta, most have been escorted back, according to local authorities. The rapid repatriation eases pressure on the city’s overstretched facilities.

stories.headline: The time filter in Google Search broke a few days ago
July 2026 newsletter
Greg Brockman Warns Against ChatGPT Spam in Workplace Slack
stories.summary: Brockman notes that employees resent automated ChatGPT messages that intrude on their workflow, even if the request is benign. The comment underscores the importance of preserving human interaction in collaborative tools.

stories.headline: Idaho Fast‑Food Shootout Leaves Three Dead, Suspect Found Dead
stories.summary: A gunman opened fire inside a restaurant, killing three patrons before police discovered his body nearby. Authorities are still piecing together the motive behind the attack.

stories.headline: Datasette‑Apps 0.2a0 Introduces Debugging and Listing Tools
stories.summary: The pre‑release adds app_debug() for invisible JavaScript testing and app_list() to enumerate editable apps via the Datasette Agent. These features streamline development and permission management for users.

stories.headline: Teen Hitmen Sold as ‘Violence‑as‑a‑Service’ by Foxtrot Network Across Europe
stories.summary: The Foxtrot Network is alleged to have hired teenagers to carry out killings, accounting for roughly 35 murders across the continent. Its business model treats murder like a contract service, sparking alarm among law‑enforcement agencies.

stories.headline: Avalanche in Pakistan Claims Legendary Climber Nirmal Purja and Team
stories.summary: A deadly snow slide on one of the world’s highest peaks wiped out a multinational climbing party that included the celebrated mountaineer Nirmal Purja. Rescue efforts were hampered by extreme altitude and weather, confirming multiple fatalities.

stories.headline: Tourist Plane Crashes Over Peru’s Nazca Lines, 13 Dead
stories.summary: A small aircraft carrying tourists stalled and fell while flying above the famous Nazca geoglyphs, killing all aboard. Local authorities opened an investigation into possible mechanical failure or pilot error.

stories.headline: 15‑Year‑Old Engineer Shares Self‑Made Cycloidal Gearbox on GitHub
stories.summary: A teenage hobbyist posted the design and source code for a cycloidal gearbox he fabricated himself, drawing significant attention on Hacker News. The project showcases advanced mechanical design skills rarely seen at that age.

stories.headline: Italy Places 19 Major Cities on Red Heat Alert as Summer Peaks
stories.summary: Heatwave warnings have escalated, with Rome, Milan, Naples and most other large cities now under the highest temperature warning. Officials warn that only two cities remain off the red alert, urging residents to adopt cooling measures.

stories.headline: ASRock BC‑250 Promises Affordable Steam Gaming PC
stories.summary: A new ASRock mini‑PC, the BC‑250, is positioned as a low‑cost entry point for SteamOS gaming, featuring modest specs aimed at casual players. Reviewers note its price advantage but caution about performance limits for modern titles.

stories.headline: Bomb Attempt at Moscow Eatery Leaves Three Dead
stories.summary: Security personnel stopped a woman carrying explosives from entering a restaurant, but the device detonated nearby, killing three people. Russian officials cited the incident as a thwarted terrorist act.

stories.headline: Adventure Icon Nirmal Purja Killed in Pakistani Avalanche, Company Confirms
stories.summary: The expedition firm led by Purja announced his death after an avalanche struck their climbing group on a high‑altitude summit. Purja was famed for summiting all 14 eight‑thousanders in just six months in 2019.

stories.headline: Why Atom Beats RSS for Modern Content Syndication
stories.summary: The article argues that the Atom format offers richer metadata, better extensibility, and improved handling of international characters compared with RSS. These technical advantages make Atom more suitable for contemporary publishing workflows.

stories.headline: Infantino Faces Growing Calls to Step Down After FIFA Turmoil
stories.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino is under intense scrutiny following the collapse of a controversial World Cup investment scheme and mounting criticism from member associations. Stakeholders question whether he can retain his position amid the organization’s recent crises.
